body:
Founder clarified the Android tablet is the kiosk's real production 'brain' (Windows stays dev/debug), with a dual-mode Feather, a Pi edge-node layer, and payment processing explicitly gated on its own go-ahead. NORTHSTAR.md updated with the full architecture, capability audit, and 4 new Android-arm phases (A1-A4). Phase A2 partially done via PARENA@6e2cba0. Commit EDGE.GAME@44a722c.

⚓ ☃
title: Android production-arm architecture resolved + Phase A2 partially done
